meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能接入 Matrix 聊天平台。它会安装并配置 Matrix 适配器,让 Claude 可以在 Matrix 房间或私信中收发消息。使用前需要你提供一个专用的 Matrix 机器人账号。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 Matrix 聊天或添加 Matrix 信道时,技能会执行安装与配置步骤。

say.text: 帮我接入 Matrix 聊天
say.note: 开始复制适配器并配置。
会安装依赖并生成凭据。

say.text: 让 Claude 用 Matrix 跟我聊天
say.note: 需要提供机器人账号或令牌。

howto.what_en: This skill adds Matrix channel support to Claude. It copies the Matrix adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, patches ESM imports, builds, tests, and guides setting up a separate bot account so Claude can chat via Matrix rooms or DMs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to integrate Matrix chat or add a Matrix channel.

say_en.note: It starts copying the adapter and configuring.
It installs dependencies and sets up credentials.

say_en.text: Let Claude chat with me via Matrix
say_en.note: You'll need to provide a bot account or token.
